text: 52-year-old male with three days of fever, productive cough, chest discomfort, reathlessness, fatigue, and reduced appetite. This is vomiting and wheezing. No known drug allergy. Past history of hypertension and type two diabetes. Community-acquired pneumonia. Temperature 101 degrees Fahrenheit, blood pressure 130/85 mmHg, pulse 92 beats per minute, respiratory rate 22, saturation 94% on room air. Complete blood count and chest x-ray. Piracetamol 650 mg twice daily. Amoxicilin with clavulanic acid as advised. Glucose monitoring diet. Liet home diet, warm fluid, do rice, adequate water. General, complete antibiotics. Daily temperature check. Return for worsening rethlessness or high fever. Follow up in three days.
